explication: Depix is a command-line proof of concept for recovering pixelated text regions by matching their colored blocks against a reference search image, then writing a reconstructed image. Its main workflow loads both images, detects and filters blocks, searches for matches, resolves ambiguous matches geometrically, and saves the result. The repository also includes a pixelation generator and a box-visualization tool. The README only notes that the project migrated; workflow details here come from the sampled source, and unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
